patch_description:
Crossover ansatz combining the best motifs from prior candidates:
- Symmetry-grouped single-qubit rotations (corners / edges / center) for parameter efficiency.
- Shared CRZ "ring" couplings on outer edges plus separate center-edge CRZs to let center interactions differ.
- Parametrized three-qubit ZZZ motifs split by geometric category (rows / columns / diagonals) to encourage line-based features.
- Doubly-controlled RZ (CCRZ) center interactions split by geometry (edge-edge-center vs corner-corner-center).
- Shared post-RZ rotations grouped by symmetry for phase flexibility and regularization.

This preserves a compact parameterization (13 unique params per block -> 78 total params with the fixed l=3, p=2) shown to improve validation/test performance in the prior runs. It keeps the fixed feature-map, re-uploading, training loop, and measurement mapping unchanged.
